feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: How Medicaid affected one California House race
entry.summary: A Republican in California's Central Valley fended off challengers for years. But his district had a lot of people on Medicaid, and he lost by a large margin this time.

entry.title: In northern Ethiopia, conflict pushes a strained healthcare system to the brink
entry.summary: Ethiopia's health care system was once considered a model in the region. But in the northern Tigray region, ongoing conflict has left health facilities and medical workers vulnerable to attacks.

entry.title: Swing voters in swing states weigh the effect of the midterm results
entry.summary: These swing voters in swing states didn't all vote for Democrats, but they are all hoping for results and lower prices.

entry.title: College Football Playoff will expand to 24 teams in another sea change for the sport
entry.summary: The College Football Playoff is expanding again. The 12-team format lasted just three years. Starting next fall, the field will expand to 24 teams in a massive moment of transformation for the sport.

entry.title: Turkey hosts world climate summit, but some critics accuse it of 'greenwashing'
entry.summary: Thousands of diplomats, executives and leaders are gathering in Turkey for a global climate summit. In recent years, Turkey has moved to be more eco-conscious, but some say that hasn't been enough.

entry.title: Nvidia shares tumble as the company says it's investigating CEO Jensen Huang
entry.summary: Nvidia's share price falls after the company begins an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's alleged relationship with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy.

entry.title: A promising new medicine against heart disease fails unexpectedly
entry.summary: Doctors expected an experimental drug that lowers a common risk factor for heart attacks would save patients' lives. The medicine made no difference.

entry.title: Paraguay bank collapse hits millions
entry.summary: A digital bank's collapse has plunged Paraguay into crisis — cutting millions off from their money and sending the president from office to detention in a matter of days.

entry.title: Scientists think they've found ancient remnants of dinosaur blood
entry.summary: Scientists have studied plenty of dinosaur bones, eggs and footprints. Now, some think they've found their strongest evidence yet of dinosaur blood.

entry.title: A quest to make a young friend smile takes one man on a sweet international journey
entry.summary: The fall 2026 Audio Flux storytelling competition features immersive short audio entries from around the world, including one about the search for an elusive box of cookies.
